name: pickup_init_and_load_puppy_spawns
description: Pickup::InitAndLoadPuppySpawns initializes pickup weapon metadata, loads puppy spawn records, creates primary spawns, and mirrors them into the network-copy list when networking is enabled.
known_limits: tier S verification was not attempted in this session; final byte matching should be handled with the coherent Pickup source-cluster pass.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly/decompilation for 0x41de70 validates pickup type metadata initialization, primary spawn-list reset, puppy ZRD load through Pickup::SelectPuppiesZrdByDifficulty, parsed spawn creation through Pickup::SpawnFromParsedZrdEntry, loaded-tree cleanup, and network-copy list cloning.
The native smoke writes a minimal puppies.zrd, runs the loader with networking enabled, and verifies a parsed primary spawn plus a matching network-copy spawn.
